question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 3, 9 and 18 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to complete thrice the same work, working together?2522
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A = 3 days

Time taken by B = 9 days

Time taken by C = 18 days

Total work = 3 times

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Efficiency = LCM ÷ Time

Total time = Total work ÷ Total efficiency

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 3, 9, 18 = 18

⇒ Efficiency of A = 18 ÷ 3 = 6

⇒ Efficiency of B = 18 ÷ 9 = 2

⇒ Efficiency of C = 18 ÷ 18 = 1

⇒ Total efficiency = 6 + 2 + 1 = 9

⇒ Total work = 3 × 18 = 54

⇒ Time = 54 ÷ 9 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**
